about_short_description.short_description: Sunlight helps companies grow an engaging learning culture by facilitating their team’s access to any book, event, or course in the world.

product.name: Sunlight Learning Platform
product.description: A platform that manages and facilitates employee access to books, events, and courses worldwide to support personal and professional growth.

product.name: Prism API
product.description: An API that enables integration of Sunlight’s platform with HRIS, LMS, and other learning providers for custom workflows and data synchronization.

product.name: Virtual MasterCard® Prepaid Card
product.description: A prepaid virtual card issued to employees for purchasing learning resources within set budget limits and approval processes.

product.name: Learning Content Curation and Playlists
product.description: Tools for creating, sharing, and managing curated learning content and playlists with AI-powered recommendations and categorization.

product.name: Budget and Wallet Management
product.description: A system to allocate, control, and monitor learning budgets at employee, team, and company levels with alerts and reporting.

identifier.value: Integrations with HR and Communication Tools

product.name: Integrations with HR and Communication Tools
product.description: Connectors for syncing users and managing permissions with HR systems like HiBob and BambooHR, and communication platforms like Slack.
